facts.business: KM Sugar Mills Limited is an integrated sugar manufacturer that processes sugarcane into sugar and converts byproducts into renewable energy and other valuable resources.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure (fixed assets capitalized and net change in CWIP)

key_risks: Valuation of sugar inventory depends on minimum selling price, monthly quota, and government notifications
Contingent liabilities from pending litigations involve significant management judgement and potential bias
facts.related_party_note: Loan to a related party of Rs 870 lakhs outstanding as at March 31, 2025; nil as at March 31, 2026.
